name: Shark
role: Apex. Sets the plan every wave; everyone else reads its lane and reacts.
home: Its own lane plus a buffer band; changes every wave
habit: One per wave. Never enters from the same edge or travels the same direction two waves in a row. Picks an attitude, then a route from that attitude.

reactions.name: Snap back
reactions.effect: Reverses along its own lane at 1.6x speed and leaves where it came in.

reactions.name: Frenzy
reactions.effect: 3 s of 1.5x speed with a hard side-to-side shake.

co_paths.name: Shadow
co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark follows 2-3 s behind in the same lane.

co_paths.name: Pincer
co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark takes the mirrored lane at the same moment, never touching.
